verdict.rationale: Mailchimp offers transactional sending through Mailchimp Transactional (formerly Mandrill), which sends event-driven messages via API or SMTP and posts webhooks for send, delivery, bounce, open and click events. That gives developers a transactional channel under the Mailchimp umbrella. However, it is a separate product and API from the Marketing API, and a community report says Mandrill still isn't integrated with Mailchimp years after the two were combined, which weakens the 'same platform, alongside marketing sends' part of the story. Missing for 10: a single unified API or account flow covering transactional and marketing sends, an explicitly documented email-send endpoint (the pack only shows an SMS send endpoint), evidence of templating for receipts and magic links, and independent hands-on corroboration.
